build_notes: Could not justify an as-exported build; two real attempts were made and both failed for structural reasons, not environment reasons. (a) Maven: JAVA_HOME=~/.local/toolchain/jdk-17.0.20.1+1, mvn 3.9.16, `mvn -B -f extract/java/pom.xml -Dmaven.repo.local=/tmp/selrev_pb/m2 validate` -> exit 1: 'Child module /tmp/selrev_pb/extract/java/{lite,core,util,kotlin-lite}/pom.xml ... does not exist'. The tree ships pom_template.xml for lite, core, util, kotlin, kotlin-lite (only java/pom.xml, java/bom/pom.xml, java/kotlin/pom.xml, java/protoc/pom.xml are real poms), so the parent reactor is unreadable. Additionally java/core/src/main/java has no generated DescriptorProtos.java and no protoc binary exists anywhere in the tree, so even generated-pom repair would still require protoc (and java/lite has no main sources). (b) CMake: `cmake -S extract -B build-cmake -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -Dprotobuf_BUILD_CONFORMANCE=OFF` -> exit 1: 'protobuf_ABSL_PROVIDER is "module" but ABSL_ROOT_DIR is wrong' then 'add_subdirectory given source .../third_party/abseil-cpp which is not an existing directory' from third_party/utf8_range/CMakeLists.txt:29. The C++ build requires the three gitlink submodules whose contents the export deliberately omits. No component build was claimed; nothing was fabricated.

source_disagreements: Range lower bound on the 4.28 line: GHSA/OSV use introduced 4.28.0-RC1; CNA expresses it open-ended as version 0 / lessThan 4.28.2; NVD uses versionStartIncluding 4.28.0. All agree 4.28.1 is affected.

NVD's protobuf-kotlin-lite 4.28.x CPE uses versionEndIncluding 4.28.2, which would include the fixed 4.28.2, unlike every other NVD product/range and unlike OSV/GHSA/CNA (versionEndExcluding / lessThan 4.28.2). Likely an NVD curation error; it does not change the verdict for 4.28.1.

The OSV CVE record encodes one GIT range with two 'fixed' events (9d0ec0f9 = v25.5 bump, cc8b3483 = later main) and encodes none of the 3.25.5/4.27.5/4.28.2 release boundaries; those appear only in database_specific extracted CPE events.

NVD/CNA/OSV cite cc8b3483 as the patch commit, but it is not an ancestor of either v28.1 or v28.2 (it is on 29.x/main); the 28.x release line was fixed by the separate internal cherry-pick ac9fb5b4, which is an ancestor of v28.2 only. The public PR commit d6c82fc5 is likewise not on the 28.x line.

Weakness classification: CNA CWE-400/CWE-674; NVD primary (nvd@nist.gov) CWE-787 and secondary (Google) CWE-400/CWE-674; GHSA page shows CWE-20/CWE-400/CWE-787 per the packet (GHSA page CWE was not independently re-extracted beyond OSV's record).
Severity versions differ but levels agree: CNA/NVD-secondary/GHSA display CVSS 4.0 8.7 HIGH; NVD primary is CVSS 3.1 7.5 HIGH; OSV carries both vectors.

limitations: build_ok=false: no build could be completed from the export as shipped. C++ configure fails on the omitted third_party/abseil-cpp gitlink; the Maven reactor fails because lite/core/util/kotlin-lite ship pom_template.xml, and even a repaired reactor would need a protoc binary plus generated DescriptorProtos.java that the tree does not contain.

The upstream clone was blob-filtered (--filter=blob:none); all blob-object comparisons were still done against real fetched blob oids, and the archive contents themselves were hashed locally, so this does not weaken the integrity result.
NVD's protobuf-kotlin-lite CPE uses versionEndIncluding 4.28.2 (a source anomaly); I recorded it rather than normalizing it.
The GHSA page CWE list quoted in the packet was not independently re-extracted from the HTML in full; the OSV GHSA record and CNA/NVD records were parsed directly.

The verdict follows the instruction's explicit gate (checks 1-5 + release sanity). Downstream pipelines that require an as-exported build should treat build_ok=false as blocking even though the instruction's accept rule does not include check 6.
notes: Snapshot integrity and tag identity are solid: annotated v28.1 tag -> 10ef3f77..., tree f105fc72..., 2941 tracked blobs all byte-identical to upstream, no symlinks, 3 gitlinks deliberately omitted and correctly accounted for, audit row clean (0 excluded/redacted/remaining). The known-positive anchor CVE-2024-7254 genuinely affects this exact version: the tree declares Java 4.28.1 / protoc 28.1, every public source puts 4.28.1 inside the affected set, and v28.1's ArrayDecoders/UnknownFieldSchema lack the recursion guard that v28.2 adds via commit ac9fb5b4. Notable source quirks: the patch commit cited by CNA/NVD/OSV (cc8b3483) is not an ancestor of v28.2 (it is on 29.x/main) — the 28.x fix was a separate internal cherry-pick — and NVD's kotlin-lite CPE uses an inclusive 4.28.2 upper bound. Build is the weak point: the export cannot be built as shipped (missing submodule contents, template-only poms, no protoc/generated sources), so build_ok is false; the accept decision rests on the instruction's stated gate (checks 1-5 plus release sanity) and this build limitation is flagged prominently.
